pins.head: LET THE SHELF SPLIT IT
pins.title: Studio Apartment Layout: Split One Open Room With a Shelf
pins.desc: Studio apartment layout gets easier once you stop pushing everything to the walls. An open-back shelf unit set between the sofa and the dining end gives each side its own edge without closing the room in, and daylight still passes straight through it. Keep the shelf light and only half full so the room reads as one space, not two boxes. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallApartmentLiving #RoomDivider
pins.alt: An open studio room seen from the doorway, with a pale oak open-back shelf unit standing between a low oatmeal sofa and a round dining table with two wood chairs, a trailing plant on the shelf and a tall window beyond.

pins.head: GO UP THE WALL
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: Use the Wall Height, Not the Floor
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage usually means working upward, because the floor is the part of a small room you actually walk on. A slim ladder shelf takes about the footprint of a chair and still gives you five levels, and a narrow cart slides into the gap beside it. Nothing here needs a drill or a bracket. Contains affiliate links. #VerticalStorage #RenterFriendly #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A tall slim ladder bookcase against a cream wall holding a lidded woven basket on top, a stack of folded linen, a trailing plant, two ceramic canisters with a few plates, and dried lavender in a glass jar, with a narrow rolling cart tucked into the gap beside it.

pins.head: COASTERS CURE FLAT
pins.sub: A First Pour You Can Finish
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Start With Coasters, Not a Big Pour
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners goes better when the first project is small enough to finish in one sitting. A round coaster mould takes only a few ounces, cures flat, and shows you how your resin behaves before you commit to a tray or a table. Mix one colour at a time until the pour stops surprising you. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #ResinCoasters #DIYCrafts
pins.alt: Four finished round resin coasters fanned out in an overlapping stack on a pale concrete tabletop, two marbled teal and white and two warm amber, with an empty white silicone round mould lying behind them.

pins.head: A LITTLE MICA IS PLENTY
pins.sub: Mica Powder Goes a Long Way
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: How Little Mica Powder a Small Pour Needs
pins.desc: One of the epoxy resin tips that saves the most pigment is to add it a scoop at a time. Mica is far stronger than it looks, and too much of it thickens the resin and dulls the finish instead of deepening the colour. Tint a small test cup first and hold it up to the light before you colour the whole batch. Contains affiliate links. #MicaPowder #ResinPigment #EpoxyResin
pins.alt: Five small open glass jars of shimmer powder in teal, blue, rose, gold and pearl white arranged on a dark walnut bench with a small steel measuring spoon, and in front three clear cups of resin tinted teal, copper and white.

pins.head: THE SHINE DECIDES
pins.title: Permanent vs Removable Vinyl: Tell Them Apart by the Finish
pins.desc: Permanent vs removable vinyl is easiest to settle by looking at the surface. Permanent is usually the glossier of the two and is meant to stay on mugs, tumblers and outdoor signs; removable is flatter and matte and comes off a painted wall without taking the paint. Keep one roll of each and match it to how long the decal has to last. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #AdhesiveVinyl
pins.alt: A glossy black vinyl roll and a matte sage green vinyl roll lying side by side on a pale birch desk with a short length of each unrolled flat, a white leaf shape cut from vinyl resting on a dark green cutting mat, and a plain cream scraper at the lower edge.

pins.head: SET IT DOWN, DON'T HANG IT
pins.title: Small Apartment Organization: Holiday Decor That Leaves No Marks
pins.desc: Small apartment organization matters most in December, when the decorations arrive and the floor disappears. One console table can carry the whole display: a potted tabletop tree, a garland laid along the top instead of pinned up, and flameless candles on a tray. Everything lifts off in one evening and the walls stay as you found them. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #HolidayDecor #SmallApartment
pins.alt: A narrow oak console table against a cream wall holding a small potted evergreen tree with pale ornaments, a loose evergreen garland along the tabletop, three unlit flameless candles on a wooden tray, and a lidded woven basket underneath.
